title: underwater-collateral: flood risk in official land values, credit under relief and bank capital (Thailand)
description: Research proposal, working paper and public-data pilot on how flood risk reaches bank capital in Thailand: whether official land values capitalise flood hazard and realised floods (a pre-specified round-to-round design on Sentinel-1 flood maps), credit under regulatory relief (estimator and power on synthetic data), and a reverse stress test on a synthetic bank. Every number in the working paper is generated by the scripts in this repository from public data; raw data are rebuilt by the download scripts logged in 03_data/README.md. Public data only; views and errors are the author's own.
